name: James
bio: James, son of Zebedee, was mending fishing nets with his father and brother John when Jesus called the two brothers to follow him; they immediately left the boat and their father to do so (Matthew 4:21-22). His place among Jesus's closest disciples is told in detail in the chapters ahead. He, along with Peter and his brother John, was taken by Jesus up a mountain to witness his transfiguration with Moses and Elijah (Matthew 17:1-8).
